title: Continuity of translations in measure on balls (L¹-continuity of translation for indicator functions)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^m (= Euclid m) be measurable and R ∈ ℝ. For z ∈ ℝ^m put F − z := {v : v + z ∈ F} and Φ(z) := L^m(((F − z) Δ F) ∩ B_R(0)), where L^m is Lebesgue measure and B_R(0) the open ball. Then Φ(z) → 0 in [0, ∞] as z → 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (R : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → Tendsto (fun z : Euclid m => volume (symmDiff ((fun v => v + z) ⁻¹' F) F ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
